Active/Inactive Option Products

Single Restaurants

POST -/products/option-products/{optionProductId}/inactivate-as-option

POST -/products/option-products/{optionProductId}/activate-as-option

 

Chain Restaurants

POST -/products/option-products/chain-id/{chainOptionProductId}/activate-as-option

POST - products/option-products/chain-id/{chainOptionProductId}/inactivate-as-option

You can activate/inactivate options with these endpoints.

You can turn your products in the Option Products menu active and inactive with the following methods. Option products in the contents of all products under this endpoint menus update their status as inacitve or active.
